stem.text: A student balances a $30\,\text{cm}$ ruler on a fulcrum set at the $15\,\text{cm}$ mark. She then places a $50\,\text{g}$ mass on the $23\,\text{cm}$ mark and a $20\,\text{g}$ mass on the $11\,\text{cm}$ mark, as shown.

stem.alt: Ruler marked from 0 to 30 resting on a triangular fulcrum. Scale marks at 0, 7, 11, 23 and 30. A dotted circle sits above the 7 mark. A filled black circle labelled 20 g sits above the 11 mark, and a filled black circle labelled 50 g sits above the 23 mark.

stem.text: Which mass should she place on the $7\,\text{cm}$ mark to restore the balance?
